name: gitlab-pane-tooling
description: Dev-time tooling only: the checks, generators and screenshots of the gitlab-pane mod. The mod itself has no npm packages and ships none (release-tree/files leaves this file out).

scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run scan
scripts.check:fast: npm run files && npm run format:check && npm run knip && npm run lint && npm run types && npm run schema -- types --check && npm run release-tree -- check && npm run docs -- check && npm run validate
scripts.lint: node --import ./tools/resolve_ts.ts tools/engine_types.ts && node --import ./tools/resolve_ts.ts node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint hooks tests specs tools chatgpt
scripts.types: node --import ./tools/resolve_ts.ts tools/engine_types.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/store-probe/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p chatgpt/tsconfig.json
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict tools/store-probe
scripts.test: vitest run && claude plugin test . && node --import ./tools/resolve_ts.ts tools/pane_screens.ts scenes && node --import ./tools/resolve_ts.ts chatgpt/move-check.ts && node --import ./tools/resolve_ts.ts chatgpt/build.ts && node --import ./tools/resolve_ts.ts chatgpt/probe.ts

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npm run check:fast && npm run scan -- --staged
